author: Fextralife

Elden Ring Tarnished Edition - Everything You Need to Know
In this video, we're going to be talking a little bit about Elden Ring Tarnished Edition, which just had its release date confirmed by FromSoftware yesterday. The release date for this is August 28 2026, which is not that far away at this point. I also want to talk about it coming to other platforms, what you can expect from the DLC, what this means for the Duskbloods, and a little bit about what the future of FromSoftware may hold at the end of the video.
